name: rubrist
description: Rubrist — turn examples of your AI failing into evaluators you can check against human judgment, and keep the evidence.

plugins.name: rubrist
plugins.description: Set up and use a Rubrist evaluator project from a coding agent. The rubrist-setup skill inspects safe project text, asks one short question, proposes a plain-language Check, and connects it as Starter · unvalidated after you choose Finish setup. The rubrist-audit skill captures real input/output examples, submits them for judging, and reports Results as counts with the human-label boundary stated plainly. Both need a running Rubrist instance; credentials stay out of chat and Git.
